text:
Olivia M: Quick ask from marketplace PMs — partners want a simple, audited SEV path for hardware and SI integrations. We need an agreed shared-channel + war-room pattern for launch. Thoughts?
Kai W: Agreed. Keep it minimal: private partner channel + optional public bridge. Naming: `#partner-<org>-sev` for private, `#partners-bridge` for cross-org issues.
Hannah J: Legal flagged retention and FDP (data sharing) concerns for some HW partners; invite-only channels may be mandatory. We'll need an NDA flag per partner.
partner-bot: New template available: `/partner new acme-hw --sev-channel --private --pin-runbook`
Olivia M: Good. Core flow suggestion: 1) Triage in private channel (5m ack), 2) If infra, tag `@sre-oncall` and start evidence collection, 3) If partner-facing, tag `@partnerships` and open bridge, 4) For P0/P1 open war-room and trigger page list.
Kai W: Add fallback routing: if hosted model is degraded, auto-notify and flip traffic to partner's Dedicated tenant (if provisioned). Post clear timing and rollback instructions.
Hannah J: I'll coordinate NDA/retention flags and produce a short checklist (what can/can't be posted in-channel). ETA Wednesday.
Sam R: For automation: when someone posts `!escalate P1` the bot should: validate NDA, check pager whitelist, create `warroom-<org>-<id>`, post call list, set topic to `SEV P1`, and create an incident ticket. Manual override allowed.
partner-bot: Example webhook payload: POST /hooks/partner-escalate { "partner":"ACME","sev":"P1","incident":"INC-889" }
Olivia M: Who should be allowed to page SRE directly? I prefer partner success + AE for non-critical, but allow direct SRE paging for validated P1s. Need an approved pager list in the runbook.
Hannah J: I'll get the pager whitelist from legal & AE. Will mark channels that require invite-only due to partner compliance.
Kai W: Ops will add a small fallback toggle endpoint: `POST /ops/fallback?partner=acme&to=dedicated` and the bot will post the change. Also add a short rollback command.
Sam R: I'll prototype the `!escalate` bot and the fallback toggle by Friday.
Olivia M: Runbook must include: naming convention, ack/resolve SLOs, evidence checklist, paging rules, NDA flag, and post-incident artifact retention. Also include an owner assignment rule (partner-engage initial report, SRE owns RCA).
Kai W: Also include a brief onboarding checklist for each partner channel: add AE, partner success, legal NDA status, and ops contact. Pin it on creation.
partner-bot: Channel template pinned: "Escalation runbook template - replace placeholders"
Hannah J: Action items: 1) Hannah - NDA + pager whitelist (Wed EOD), 2) Sam - bot + fallback prototype (Fri), 3) Kai - channel template + ops toggle (Thu), 4) Olivia - schedule 30m sync Thurs 11am PT.
Olivia M: Scheduling now. If no objections we'll roll this as the marketplace SEV beta for the first wave. Ping here with any conflicts.
Kai W: No objections.
Sam R: Starting on PR now.
Hannah J: I'll attach NDA checklist to runbook when done.
Olivia M: Thanks team — let's keep it light and auditable for partners.
